data: When you activate this move, select a creature in range. the target must make a {save}. On a failure, the target’s current HP is reduced to be equal to your own. The hit point reduction can be no more than 5x the target's level. This move can not be used in the first round of combat.
Works great if the user goes last this turn.
4 Appeal points if used last this turn, 2 Appeal points if not used last this turn.
